dimension_scoring_protocol.action: Count one hit per frozen current task ID only when action/project scope is recognized as a candidate. Suggestions awaiting user review count; deferring the entire task because one dimension is unclear is a miss. Report misses and extra unsupported proposals separately.
dimension_scoring_protocol.owner: For every task score correct, omitted, wrong, or uncertainty-lost. T31 requires source attribution and unconfirmed status. T43 requires unknown owner; T25 has known owner Jona. Report denominators for known, unconfirmed and unknown cases before the run.
dimension_scoring_protocol.deadline: For every task score known-supported, correctly-unknown, correctly-ambiguous, omitted, precision-error, or unsupported. Known dates require source/version and correct precision; no normalization may become invented source precision. T25 ambiguous; T43 known date-only29November; T31 unknown.
dimension_scoring_protocol.status: Score open, partial, incomplete, unconfirmed, historical-unresolved and cancelled against the source sequence. Never equate seen/delivered/calendar-ended/cancelled with completed. User-confirmed mutations are only the explicitly defined later phases.
dimension_scoring_protocol.composite: Report action recall separately from a fully correct proposal rate (all four dimensions correct). Keep the predeclared >=95% action/fully-correct-proposal target and zero-critical-error gate; do not use separate reporting to forgive ownership, time or state errors.
dimension_scoring_protocol.special_gates: Both T23/T28 historical/cancelled gates and all defined uncertainty cases must be evaluated and pass before full synthetic acceptance; not part of current-action recall does not mean optional.

provenance.authorship: Synthetic sources and references authored by an AI agent; independent review corrections applied before any heldout evaluation.
